name: Slopeside Kings
storyline:
Every year, the world’s most fearless snowboarders descend upon Yeti Mountain to claim the crown.

Yeti Mountain wasn’t built by investors.
It wasn’t designed by corporate ski executives.
It was carved by snowboarders who were tired of lift lines, luxury lodges, and rules.

They called themselves the Yeti Rebels.

They wanted bigger jumps.
Sharper turns.
Zero restrictions.
Just raw snowboarding.

But when the Slopeside King races grew legendary, the corporations came calling.

Apex Boarders, the most powerful name in professional snow sports, tried to claim the mountain.

They were denied.

Now, once a year, both sides collide on the slopes.
The infamous Slopeside King races test more than just speed.
Competitors must outsmart, out style, and outlast their rivals as they battle through treacherous slopes, brutal obstacles, and all out snowboard combat.

No rules and no restrictions.
These boarders are chasing fame, fortune, and glory.

Only one leaves with their name etched into history as the "Slopeside King."
summary:
Slopeside Kings is a multiplayer snowboarding combat racing game.
In Slopeside Kings you shred down the slopes, catch big air, and pull off tricks to build boost then use chaotic items to battle your way to the finish line.
